presets.name: martinct German Shepherd / Belgian Malinois K9 Dog 1.0.1
presets.notes: The mod replaces the stock shepherd. AdvancedK9 dynamically clamps coat, drawable and texture indices exposed by the installed files.

presets.name: PopcornRP Pets free Dobermann add-on
presets.notes: The open add-on files publish model name doberman and three head textures. AdvancedK9 falls back to the known retriever-replacement model if the add-on is absent.
